prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted 2D platformer production prototype tile atlas. Muted moss green, warm brown earth, cool blue-gray stone, painterly texture with crisp readable silhouettes. Strict orthographic FRONT/SIDE ELEVATION, never isometric, top-down, 3D perspective or an environment scene. No characters, text, labels, numbers, borders, grid strokes, ground shadows, glow, scenery or presentation board. Transparent PNG, true alpha-zero in empty space. All cells equal, no gutters, no outer margin; artwork never crosses cell boundaries. ONE SQUARE atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows,16 square directional MATERIAL TRANSITION overlays. In each cell the named material occupies only its named half and reaches the three outside edges of that half; opposite half is completely transparent so a base tile can show through. Irregular natural join near center only, no wide fuzzy halo. Row1 cool blue-gray rough stone occupies LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF, UPPER HALF, LOWER HALF respectively; overlays for grass/soil. Row2 sturdy warm-brown root/bark occupies LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF, UPPER HALF, LOWER HALF; overlays for grass/soil. Row3 fitted blue-gray temple masonry occupies LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF, UPPER HALF, LOWER HALF; overlays for rough stone. Row4 warm brown dry earth occupies LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF, UPPER HALF, LOWER HALF; overlays for dark wet soil. Exactly4 tiles every row,16 total. No floating decorative boulders, vegetation, glows, frame boxes or scenes. No visible depth. Source designed for64px square export; surface scale and local colors compatible with handpainted grasssoil,root and stone materials. Four directional blends per material, not a full corner-aware autotile system.
